mcarinfidelity.configuration.title: MCAR Infidelity Settings
mcarinfidelity.configuration.eligibility: Who is eligible and when. Age, family, and opt-in checks are fixed.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.minHeartsNo: Hearts needed with a player who is not the villager's partner.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.minHeartsPa: Hearts needed when the player is promised, engaged, or married to the villager.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.maxDistance: Maximum distance in blocks between participants.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.recentHurtS: Seconds after taking damage during which someone counts as busy.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.requestTime: Seconds before an unanswered player request expires.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.villagerThi: Seconds a villager waits before answering.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.declineCool: Seconds before asking the same target again after a decline.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.sessionDura: How long an interaction lasts when the scene is shown. Either participant can stop at any time.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.heartsOnCom: Hearts a villager gains when an interaction completes.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.moodOnCompl: Mood a villager gains when an interaction completes.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.wantsChildr: Chance a villager wants children, rolled once and kept. Personality shifts it. Only affects villagers that haven't rolled yet.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.nonPartnerU: For villagers who want children: chance per request to go without protection with someone who isn't their engaged or married partner.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.pregnancy.t: Conception and gestation. Time counts while the carrier is loaded or online.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.gestationDa: Length of a pregnancy in Minecraft days (20 minutes each).
mcarinfidelity.configuration.recoveryDay: Days after a birth before the mother can conceive again.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.notifyPregn: Pregnant players get a subtle hint a quarter of the way through.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.skippedSess: How long the fade to black lasts when the scene is skipped.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.privacyHome: Chance a villager only wants to be intimate at her own home. Rolled once per villager; personality shifts it.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.privacyAnyw: Chance a villager doesn't mind where, or who's around. Everyone else wants somewhere private.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.onlookerRad: Blocks within which another player or villager with line of sight counts as watching.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.privacyInte: Villagers who care about privacy stop if someone comes into view during a session.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.peakConcept: Chance of conception after an unprotected session on the day of ovulation.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.baseConcept: Chance of conception outside the fertile window.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.cycle.toolt: The cycle of female players and villagers. Follows the world clock.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.cycleLength: Length of a cycle in Minecraft days. Phases scale with it.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.cycleShareH: Hearts a villager needs before telling a non-partner about her cycle.
